o1.biggest_strength: It directly attacks the two real leaks in the data: the courier-scan silence causing day 3 to 5 tickets, and bra fit uncertainty driving half of all returns.
o1.biggest_mistake: The SMS day-3 update needs a consent/transactional check, and the portal sales-kept number is revenue kept rather than gross profit.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add consent-safe channel rules, a tighter gross-profit view for swaps, and specify that post-delivery bra messages prioritise first-time bra buyers.

o2.biggest_strength: The numbers are clean, well worked, and honest about the fit-finder selection effect instead of assuming the full 19-point gain.
o2.biggest_mistake: It misses the short day-3 proactive update, which is one of the cheapest and clearest fixes for the 6,076 day 3 to 5 tickets.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add the day-3 order-status message, tailor the portal more strongly to size-return reasons, and replace the final 'to confirm' section with stated assumptions.

reason: Output 1 is the one I could hand to the post-purchase team fastest: it has the day-3 WISMO fix, the fit messages, and the size-swap portal logic in the right order. Output 2 has slightly cleaner measurement, but it leaves out a key proactive delivery update and is a little less ready to run.
